tools.name: Clipboard Manager
tools.description: Historique du presse-papiers : retrouvez et recollez tout ce que vous avez copié.
tools.author: Es-somid Abdelhakim

en.name: Clipboard Manager
en.description: Clipboard history: find and paste again anything you copied.

shortcut.label: Keyboard shortcut
shortcut.description: Opens the clipboard history from any application.

maxItems.label: History size
maxItems.description: Pinned items are never removed automatically.

saveHistory.label: Keep history after restart
saveHistory.description: Stored locally on this computer only.

ignoreSecrets.label: Ignore passwords
ignoreSecrets.description: Copies marked as secret by password managers (KeePassXC…) are never saved.

autoClear.label: Clear history automatically
autoClear.description: Removes unpinned items older than the selected duration.

tools.name: Notes
tools.description: Bloc-notes structuré : carnets, titres, listes, cases à cocher et recherche. S'ouvre avec Win + Shift + N et n'utilise aucune ressource une fois fermé.
tools.author: Es-somid Abdelhakim

en.name: Notes
en.description: Structured notepad: notebooks, headings, lists, checklists and search. Opens with Win + Shift + N and uses no resources once closed.

shortcut.label: Keyboard shortcut
shortcut.description: Opens your notes from any application.

tools.name: Smart Window Manager
tools.description: Gestion intelligente des fenêtres : Always On Top, organisation automatique et espaces de travail restaurés en un clic.
tools.author: Es-somid Abdelhakim

en.name: Smart Window Manager
en.description: Smart window management: Always On Top, automatic arrangement and workspaces restored in one click.

shortcut.label: Always On Top
shortcut.description: Pins the active window on top. The same shortcut unpins it.

arrangeShortcut.label: Arrange windows
arrangeShortcut.description: Automatically arranges the windows of the current workspace.

options.master: Main window 70% + others on the right

showBorder.label: Border on pinned windows
showBorder.description: A colored border and a pin show windows that stay on top.

showIndicator.label: Menu in the top bar
showIndicator.description: One-click access to workspaces and window arrangement.

layouts.label: Workspaces
layouts.description: Arrange your windows (e.g. VS Code 70%, Terminal 30%, floating docs), save, then get this environment back in one click or with its keyboard shortcut: closed applications are launched, open ones are put back in place.

shortcut.label: Keyboard shortcut (optional)
shortcut.description: Opens or rearranges this workspace from anywhere, without opening Powernux.

shortcut.label: Keyboard shortcut
shortcut.description: Leave empty to remove the shortcut.

tools.name: Voice Typing
tools.description: Dictée vocale : maintenez le raccourci, parlez, relâchez. Le texte est transcrit, copié et collé automatiquement.
tools.author: Es-somid Abdelhakim

en.name: Voice Typing
en.description: Voice typing: hold the shortcut, speak, release. The text is transcribed, copied and pasted automatically.

shortcut.label: Keyboard shortcut
shortcut.description: Hold to dictate, release to transcribe. Short press: hands-free dictation (press again to finish).

provider.label: Transcription service
provider.description: The audio is sent to this service to be converted to text.

apiKey.label: Groq API key
apiKey.description: Create it on console.groq.com. Stored only on this computer.

autoPaste.label: Paste automatically
autoPaste.description: Pastes the text into the active application as soon as transcription ends (it also stays in the clipboard).

openaiApiKey.label: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: Create it on platform.openai.com. Stored only on this computer.

assemblyaiApiKey.label: AssemblyAI API key
assemblyaiApiKey.description: Create it on assemblyai.com (dashboard → API Keys). Stored only on this computer.

customFormat.label: API format
customFormat.description: How the audio is sent to the provider.

customUrl.label: API address
customUrl.description: OpenAI format: full URL, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1/audio/transcriptions. AssemblyAI format: base URL, e.g. https://api.assemblyai.com.

customModel.label: Model
customModel.description: Model name (e.g. whisper-1, whisper-large-v3). Empty: provider default.

tools.name: AI Face Assistant
tools.description: Un visage IA animé apparaît dans un notch pour expliquer vos erreurs (Docker, services, terminal) et proposer la correction. Fonctionne avec Groq, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, OpenRouter ou Ollama en local.
tools.author: Es-somid Abdelhakim

en.name: AI Face Assistant
en.description: An animated AI face appears in a notch to explain your errors (Docker, services, terminal) and suggest a fix. Works with Groq, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, OpenRouter or local Ollama.

shortcut.label: Analyze selection
shortcut.description: Select an error (terminal, browser…) then press the shortcut.

watchErrors.label: Watch for errors automatically
watchErrors.description: Off by default. If you turn it on, Powernux reads the system journal and, when a watched service fails, sends the error lines to the selected AI provider to explain them. With Ollama, nothing leaves your computer.

watchList.label: Watched services
watchList.description: Comma-separated names (journal identifiers or systemd units).

provider.label: AI provider
provider.description: The analyzed text is sent to this service. Ollama runs locally, with no key and no data sent.

groqApiKey.label: Groq API key
groqApiKey.description: Create it on console.groq.com. Stored only on this computer.

openaiApiKey.label: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: Create it on platform.openai.com. Stored only on this computer.

geminiApiKey.label: Google Gemini API key
geminiApiKey.description: Create it on aistudio.google.com (Get API key). Stored only on this computer.

mistralApiKey.label: Mistral API key
mistralApiKey.description: Create it on console.mistral.ai. Stored only on this computer.

openrouterApiKey.label: OpenRouter API key
openrouterApiKey.description: Create it on openrouter.ai/keys. Stored only on this computer.

ollamaModel.label: Ollama model
ollamaModel.description: Model installed with “ollama pull”, e.g. llama3.2, qwen2.5, mistral.

model.label: Model (overrides the default)
model.description: Exact model name at the selected provider. Empty: default model.

actions.demo: Try with a sample Docker error

tools.name: Focus Mode
tools.description: Mode concentration : ouvre vos outils de travail, coupe les notifications, bloque les distractions et suit votre session (minuteur ou Pomodoro) dans un notch.
tools.author: Es-somid Abdelhakim

en.name: Focus Mode
en.description: Focus mode: opens your work tools, mutes notifications, blocks distractions and tracks your session (timer or Pomodoro) in a notch.

pauseShortcut.label: Pause / resume
pauseShortcut.description: Pauses or resumes the current session.

playSound.label: End-of-phase sound
playSound.description: A subtle sound at the end of each phase (work, break).

notchStyle.label: Notch display
notchStyle.description: Hover the notch to show controls and the calendar.

modes.label: Focus modes
modes.description: Each mode opens its applications, mutes notifications and hides distracting applications for the whole session.
modes.empty: No mode yet: create one below.

pomodoro.label: Pomodoro
pomodoro.description: Alternates work and breaks (25 / 5 min, long break every 4 sessions).

blockApps.label: Applications to block
blockApps.description: Their windows are minimized during work (allowed during breaks).

tools.name: Screenshot
tools.description: Capture d'écran avec Win + Shift + S, comme sous Windows : zone, fenêtre ou écran entier, copiée automatiquement dans le presse-papiers.
tools.author: Es-somid Abdelhakim

en.name: Screenshot
en.description: Take a screenshot with Win + Shift + S: area, window or full screen, copied to the clipboard automatically.

shortcut.label: Screenshot shortcut
shortcut.description: Opens the capture tool: select an area, a window or the whole screen.

tools.name: Project Dashboard
tools.description: Tableau de bord de vos projets : technologies détectées, dernière modification, et ouverture en un clic dans VS Code, le terminal ou lancement du projet.
tools.author: Es-somid Abdelhakim

en.name: Project Dashboard
en.description: Dashboard of your projects: detected technologies, last change, and one-click opening in VS Code, the terminal, or running the project.

roots.label: Project folders
roots.description: Folders to scan (comma-separated). Projects are detected up to 2 levels deep.

projects.label: My projects
projects.empty: No project found: check “Project folders” or add a project below.

tools.name: Smart File Organizer
tools.description: Range automatiquement un dossier par type (Images, Documents, Code, Archives…) et détecte les fichiers en double pour libérer de l'espace.
tools.author: Es-somid Abdelhakim

en.name: Smart File Organizer
en.description: Automatically sorts a folder by type (Images, Documents, Code, Archives…) and finds duplicate files to free up space.

organize.label: Suggested organization
organize.description: Files in the folder are grouped by type. Nothing is moved without your approval.

duplicates.label: Duplicate files
duplicates.description: Files with exactly the same content (compared byte by byte with SHA-256). The original is kept, copies go to the trash.

tools.name: AI Copilot
tools.description: Assistant d'intelligence artificielle intégré au bureau, dans un notch moderne : lié au terminal pour expliquer et corriger les commandes, capture d'une zone de l'écran pour obtenir de l'aide sur ce qui s'y trouve, et bien plus. Bientôt disponible.

en.name: AI Copilot
en.description: An artificial intelligence assistant built into your desktop, in a modern notch: connected to the terminal to explain and fix commands, able to capture an area of the screen to help you with what is there, and much more. Coming soon.
